inlines.v: SCLAVO'NIAN, SCLEROT'IC, adjective [Gr. hard; hardness.] Hard; firm; as the sclerotic coat or tunicle of the eye. SCLEROT'IC, noun 1. The firm white outer coat of the eye. 2. A medicine which hardens and consolidates the parts to which it is applied.
